releases.notes:
## What's Changed

### Protection and energy

- Added per-world server configuration for Phase Guard and Emergency Revival behavior, energy costs, recovery, effects, and dimension requirements.
- Corrected configured energy costs to consume the documented FE amount through Mekanism's FE-to-Joules conversion.
- Fixed Phase Guard damage handling to avoid NeoForge damage-container accumulation while preserving full protection.
- Kept Chaos Anchor strictly subordinate to an active Phase Guard with no additional energy drain.
- Fixed Emergency Revival so it only activates when its module is enabled and sufficiently powered; it intentionally has no cooldown.

### HUD and localization

- Aligned Phase Guard and Emergency Revival HUD availability with server-side suit, dimension, configuration, and energy checks.
- Removed fixed configurable values from module descriptions across all 30 locales.
- Improved protection event logging and post-revival recovery configuration.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Lumysia/mekanism-extra-modules/compare/v1.21.1-0.1.0-alpha.1...v1.21.1-0.1.0-alpha.2
